ownerThemes.theme: Owners like getting a 5-thread serger and coverstitch in one box for roughly $450 to $650 and report clean stitches once set up.
In coverstitch mode there is little room under the foot; pressing the lifter bar further down helps slide fabric in. Some report the right needle skipping and the triple cover never forming.
Singer 2022 needles are required and hard to find, especially size 11; threading is described as difficult until learned.

editorial.verdict: The Professional 5 is the one-box answer for serging and coverstitch: 2/3/4/5 thread, 1,300 spm, 14 stitches, with a manual conversion between modes.
editorial.whoFor: A sewist short on space or budget who wants a 5-thread safety stitch and coverstitch and accepts a several-minute changeover.
editorial.skipIf: You switch between seaming and hemming many times per project; two dedicated machines will be faster.
editorial.keySpec: 2/3/4/5 thread · serger + coverstitch · 1,300 spm · 3.0 to 9.8 mm width
strengths: Only machine in this set with 5-thread safety stitch and coverstitch in one unit.
Stitch width 3.0 to 9.8 mm and differential feed 0.6 to 2.0 published by dealers.
Singer's 25-year frame warranty with 2 years on electrical parts.
weaknesses: Requires Singer 2022 needles, which owners report are hard to find.
Coverstitch mode has limited clearance under the foot and reviewers report right-needle skips.
Mechanical parts and adjustments are covered for only 90 days.

checks.title: Conversion steps
checks.body: Switching modes means moving the blade, changing the plate, shifting needles and flipping the clutch. Reviewers time it at about seven minutes once learned.

checks.title: Needle stock
checks.body: Singer 2022 in 14/90 ships with it; the manual allows 11/80 too. Order spares with the machine rather than hunting locally.
